pages.title: The Herbalist's Warning
pages.text: Every spiritual herb possesses its own nature. Fire-aligned plants may conflict with frost-born flowers, while herbs of shadow may resist those of pure yang. True alchemy requires more than rare ingredients: one must understand harmony, opposition, and the delicate balance of spiritual energies.

pages.title: Closing Words
pages.text: Those who recognize the hundred herbs may discover the treasures of heaven and earth. Those who understand their nature may finally approach the path of alchemy.
